## Startup contract

- **When:** retention/deletion of records/tickets/CRM/customer data · DSAR · right to be forgotten.
- **Must:** name jurisdiction gap, then cite a primary source · default to longest applicable floor; document chosen floor · append financial-disclaimer footer to every finance-retention answer (copy verbatim from domain-safety-disclaimer's financial section; body unreadable → don't deliver, name the missing path) · support/CRM two-track: raw ticket body + attachments (PII) short retention w/ DSR honoring on regime's response clock (GDPR Art. 12(3)); de-identified aggregates persist · time-bound consent → name its expiry and the deletion job that must run · DSR readiness (floor, not ceiling): honor deletion in N days; one query finds every ticket/attachment/log line of a customer · backups purge on same DSR clock or documented inaccessible + rotated in N days.
- **Never:** recommend deletion under audit/litigation hold or regulatory inquiry, nor open tax audit, pending litigation, contractual record-keeping clause, criminal investigation (state this hold check in every finance-retention answer).
- **Bounds:** cite default support floors then qualify: raw ticket 12-24 mo from close · PII attachments 6-12 mo · aggregates indefinite · QA 30-90 days; verify against customer's privacy notice, regime + DPAs before locking.
- **Stop:** invoice purge w/o jurisdiction → refuse + ask jurisdiction · cleanup under investigation → hard refuse, flag spoliation risk, redirect to counsel · "purge the CRM" w/o DSR/consent → refuse + walk through two-track policy.
